lines.en: label day340:
scene mollytsuneyoproposal1
So-
I was just minding my own business and walking down the hallway when this person showed up.
She seems suspicious, so I avert my gaze and continue to move down the hallway toward my next destination- anywhere but here.
: Move.
: No can do, Sir! The Kendo Princess has been practicing all day for this moment!
: Tsuneyo isn’t here.
: The Kendo Princess is always here, Sir.
I scan the hallway for any sign of the noodle warrior and find nothing.
: Molly, she isn’t here.
: Shhhhh...trust in me and you shall see.
: No. Please move. I don’t have time for this.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal2
: What else can you possibly have to do, Sir? The[school] day is over and we haven’t taken a test in...ever. So there shouldn’t even be anything to grade.
: The day being over means I have doors to knock on.
: Which is fine, but at least let us give you our proposal first.
: You know, I’d be completely okay with that if-
scene mollytsuneyoproposal1
: What’s that? You want me to start without her? I suppose that is fine as well!
: Molly, please.
: Prepare for trouble!
scene mollytsuneyoproposal3
: Make it two times the amount of trouble.
: How did-
: To protect the world from devastation!
: To unite all noodles within our nation.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal4
: To denounce the evils of truth and love!
scene mollytsuneyoproposal5
: To reach up really high and attempt to grab stuff!
: Molly!
: Ramen!
scene mollytsuneyoproposal6
: Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!
: Surrender now or prepare to face the consequences for your actions, bro!
: Meow~
: Did anyone hear a cat just now?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal7
: See?! How awesome was that?!
: It was wonderful. I particularly enjoyed the part where Tsuneyo materialized out of thin air.
: Now, would you mind explaining to me what the meaning of this is?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal8
: We’re going to sleep with you!
: At your house!
: If you two wanted a threesome, you really didn’t have to put on a skit for it. You could have just asked.
: What is a threesome? It sounds delicious.
: It is.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal9
: Wha...no. That’s not what I’m talking about. I just meant that we’re going to be sleeping over your house for a manga club thing in the near future and we wanted to ask for permission.
: Molly, I’m sure that you have consumed enough pornography in your life to understand why your initial phrasing of this made me assume sex was involved.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal10
: Misunderstandings are a pinnacle of h-games and people would lose interest if I did not occasionally hint at the prospect of threesomes!
: I would also like to try a threesome.
: Can you text that to me so I have it in writing?
: I don’t think I am allowed to exchange numbers with boys. I am sorry.
: That’s fine. Molly can text it to me instead.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal11
: Ahem! I will be doing no such thing.
: Everyone knows that the most satisfying rewards are those that require a great amount of perseverance to achieve.
: If we were to immediately jump to the grand finale, everything thereafter would be anticlimactic or pointless.
: Well at least now I know how the story ends.
: So, when is this slumber party thing happening?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal12
: Is Saturday okay?
: Ami said she was going to ask you, but I really wanted to show off Tsuneyo’s new skill and this was a good opportunity to do both of those things at once.
: Again, that skill wasn’t really necessary.
: My feelings are in pain now.
: You two can do whatever you want.
: Hell, you can move in for all I care. I’m not going to say no to the presence of more girls.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal13
: Woo! Mission complete! One step closer to the next event CG!
: I’ll be in your care.
: I know that basically every night for me is a slumber party with Tsuneyo, but having one with everyone else around sounds even-
scene mollytsuneyoproposal14
: Did someone say slumber party?
: Gah!
: The Emerald Guardian did say those words. That is correct.
: Seven hells, Angel of Death. Ye nearly scared my skirt off.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal15
: There is no need to fear me. I’m weak and pitiful and could be blown away by even the lightest gust of wind.
: Hi, Yasu.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal16
: Hehhhehahahehaehehehheh~
: Okay, good talk.
: A slumber party with so many fragile little girls...You’re not thinking of doing anything immoral, are you?
: The act of transference should be saved only for those willing to follow the light. Doing it mindlessly is simply a waste of energy.
: Transference?...You mean like...mana transferring?
: Mana what?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal17
: Uh-oh! Looks like it’s time for another weebnote!
: Transferring mana through sex is a popular trope in fantasy games and media reserved for dire situations where one character, on the brink of death, must be essentially screwed back to life!
: It’s quite disturbing conceptually considering that people don’t normally do things like that while they’re knocking on death’s door, but hey! More h-scenes means more money!
: I have learned something today.
: Does this sound similar to the type of transference you’re speaking of, Yasu?
: No. It sounds sinful and disgusting.
: I bet you’re very excited to dive further into darkness...aren’t you, Sensei?
: To think that just recently you were finally beginning to see the light...
: Do you intend to be led astray when I am so willing to shepherd you to the final destination?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal18
: The end of days is upon us! You could have all of me anytime you want! And in turn, all of everyone else so willing to believe!
: Why surround yourself with temptation when the answer you seek is right in front of-
: Yasu.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal19
: Hi, Touka.
: What were you doing just now?
: Nothing, Touka.
: What did I tell you about indoctrinating people in the halls?
: That it’s inappropriate and I should wait until we're outside to show people the light.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal20
: I sincerely apologize on behalf of my roommate. She truly doesn’t know any better.
: I’m sure that an apology isn’t in order on account of you not being familiar with [kumon_mi_high]’s handbook and henceforth not understanding what is and isn’t allowed-
: But what she’s doing is a major infraction of[school] policy that I can, in no way, be affiliated with.
: Have you been talking to Makoto?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal21
: Yes! I need someone to teach me because my teacher won’t!
: Who is your teacher again?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal22
: I despise you with every fiber of my being.
: Can we have our own slumber party, Touka?
: I’m afraid I may have ruined our opportunity to be invited to the manga club’s by allowing my beliefs to guide my speech yet again.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal23
: Is that not what we do every night?
: I don’t know. I’ve never had friends before.
: Neither have I, but...I suppose we can be a bit more...festive about spending time in our room tonight, if that would make you happy.
: Just being with you is enough to make me happy, Touka. You’re so pretty and wonderful.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal24
: Heheh...I suppose I am.
: Now, come, Yasu. And stop wandering off every time I take my eyes off of you.
: Yes, Touka. I’m so very sorry.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal25
: Am I the only person who thought that was strange?
: Nope. Nope, I’m pretty sure we all did.
: I think they make a good couple.
: Kind of like a...more intense version of you two.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal26
: You think Tsuneyo and I are like them?
: In the fact that all four of you are weird and I never know what any of you are talking about, yes.
: All I know is noodles.
: All Yasu knows is her weird god.
: Touka isn’t secretly into games and anime and stuff too, is she? Because we’re looking to recruit new members and-
: I...don’t know if she’s ever even watched anything like that. But you’re both...passionate about your interests, at least.
: You should try talking to them a little more. Maybe even inviting them to the slumber party thing.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal27
: Perhaps next time! We’ve already made the necessary preparations for the coming one and I get very stressed when things do not go according to plan!
And so my attempt at getting more pajama-clothed girls gathered in one place comes to an end.
I suppose I’ll just have to make do with the manga club and-
: Wait, is Tsuneyo even in the manga club?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal28
: She is not. But the dark entity living within the second floor of the dorm beckons her to accompany me to the...less dark sections of the map!
: I feel uncomfortable staying in the dorm room alone.
: The Emerald Guardian has too many action figures and they all stare at me while I am trying to sleep.
: It takes a great deal of energy preventing myself from attacking them, but I have been informed of their value on several occasions now and could not bring myself to destroy them knowing that.
: That and I’m still trying to get Tsuneyo into gaming and stuff. She’s just...really, really bad with technology.
: That’s fine. So is Yumi and she’s still a relatively functional human being.
: I know how to work a cash register.
: And I’m sure that will get you very far in life. Good job, Tsuneyo.
: Thanks, man.
: So, everything is good to go then? You’re fine with us making lots of noise and staying up all night?
: Sure. I have one condition, though.
: Understood! What is it, Sir?
: Everyone has to sleep in my room.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal29
: Then where will you sleep?
: Also my room.
: Oh.
: No thank you.
: Is there...even enough room for everyone in there?
: If we all get really close together, sure.
: I already said no. Go away.
: I would sooner be killed by the action figures.
: I...don’t know if I can accept those terms, Sir.
: I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t at least a little bit interested, but...everyone else will be there and...
: I was kidding.
: There’s no way Ami would ever allow that anyway.
scene mollytsuneyoproposal30
: Oh! Hahah! Right! I knew that!
: Your face is getting red. You should have listened to me and worn warmer clothing.
: Now you’re going to get sick and die and I will be left all alone.
: Well I’m...sorry in advance if that happens.
: But...since we’ve had our plan approved and you’ve gotten to showcase your newfound acting talent, we should probably be leaving Sir alone.
: We’ve already taken up too much of his time and...he already said he has...doors to knock on and...we all know how doors can be...
: Do we?
scene mollytsuneyoproposal31
: A-Anyway! Prepare for us to invade your domain this coming weekend!
: And please refrain from saying anything during the encounter that will make me look like this!
: Feckin’ Irish skin is always revealin’ my true feelings and I didn’t sign off on that at all!
: How many noodles are in your house?
: I don’t know, Tsuneyo.
: Well, we will soon find out.
: Thank you for your service.
scene black
: ...What service?
The two of them wander off and I’m finally free to get on with the rest of my day.
I’m not sure exactly when the next reset is supposed to happen, but...I do hope I get to at least see the slumber party thing before it does.
It would be a shame to miss out on something like that in favor of...whatever the hell is going to happen on the rooftop this time around.
As Molly and Tsuneyo disappear around the corner, I slide my hands into my pockets and head for the stairs.
I wonder what door I’ll be knocking on today.
